name: The Postcard Planet
description: A tiny spherical planet floats in space, its surface a patchwork of postcard-like landscapes.
prompt: Tiny spherical planet floating in a starry void, its surface a patchwork of postcard landscapes: tropical beach, snowy mountain, green forest, desert canyon, glowing city, and ocean, held gently by a giant hand, dreamy cosmic lighting, detailed illustration, no text, no logos.
caption: If you could send one postcard from an entire planet, which view would you choose? 🌍💌
